description: What generate would charge for exactly these settings, at the key's own rates: the units billed, the charge, and the developer's own price for the same request where one is on record. The settings are checked as a real request's would be, so a wrong value fails here, not at the model. Nothing runs and nothing is charged. Needs the key. Live from POST /v1/generations/quote.

input.description: The model's settings, as media_model lists them under params: prompt, size or aspect_ratio, resolution, duration, image_urls, text, voice... A setting left out takes the model's default.

model.description: A media model id from list_media_models.

name: media_quote
title: Price a generation before running it
